Unit sizes run from about 51 to 232 m², and the contractor is Reportage's own TIJ Contracting. Mostakbal City extends New Cairo towards the New Administrative Capital between Suez Road and the Regional Ring Road.
From the units listed with us in October 2026: a townhouse of about 218 m² at about EGP 9.2M.

The listed plan is 10% down, another 10% on delivery and the rest over 12 years, with delivery around December 2026. Budget for the delivery payment and the maintenance deposit.
It suits buyers who want a townhouse or apartment in Mostakbal City close to handover. Compare it in our Mostakbal City guide.
